reply_text:
I answered Tobias in his DM: his standing call with the Tansleigh Packaging team is on Fridays at 16:15, for the Osprey rollout.

The answer comes from a note I kept after Tobias told me this himself in a DM on 14 Oct. He was the one asking, and I replied in that same private DM, so nothing reached anyone else. I didn't check his calendar, because he had said no event was needed. I offered to add it to his calendar if he wants.
